channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: Wrong-network crypto: recovery depends on who controls the key
item.description: Sent crypto to the wrong network? Often you can get it back if you control the receiving wallet; exchange deposits need support, and contract cases may be unrecoverable.

item.title: Bridge confirmation waits, chain by chain
item.description: How many block confirmations do bridges wait for on each chain? Most follow finality: about 13 minutes on Ethereum, seconds on Solana, with bridge-specific thresholds.

item.title: A Solana USDC deposit needs a token account of its own
item.description: An associated token account on Solana is the standard USDC receiving account; learn why it must exist, how bridging uses it, and who funds its deposit.

item.title: Verified contracts on Etherscan and what source matching confirms
item.description: What is a verified contract on Etherscan? It means the published source code compiles to the bytecode deployed at that address, making the code readable.

item.title: EU proposal puts Russia-linked crypto routes in sanctions crosshairs
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd Russia package would target crypto and payment networks, including evasion routes through third countries; all 27 EU states must approve it.

item.title: Stablecoin holders: Aave or Compound for USDC lending?
item.description: Aave vs Compound for lending stablecoins: Aave lets supplied USDC serve as collateral; Compound III suits a simpler single-market supply. Compare rates and risk.

item.title: How to Unwrap WETH to ETH on Base from a Wallet
item.description: How to unwrap WETH to ETH on Base: call withdraw on the Base WETH contract to receive native ETH, with a little ETH set aside for gas first.

item.title: SparkLend borrowing modes: Which one fits your loan?
item.description: SparkLend borrowing modes compared: standard keeps borrowing flexible, E-Mode boosts correlated assets, and isolation caps debt against riskier collateral.

item.title: How to Bridge ETH to Linea for a First Deposit
item.description: For your first bridge, add Linea to MetaMask, use the official bridge to deposit ETH from Ethereum, and wait for ETH to appear at the same address.

item.title: EU proposal widens Russia crypto sanctions to evasion networks
item.description: The Commission’s proposed 22nd Russia package would extend bank and crypto enforcement, but still needs approval from all 27 EU states before it can take effect.

item.title: Is It Safe to Bridge USDT? Risks and safeguards
item.description: Is it safe to bridge USDT? Usually, yes, with an established service and careful checks—but bridge contracts, fake sites and token approvals add risks.

item.title: SEC staff backs Molecule’s research-token model on stated terms
item.description: The SEC staff’s conditional response covers LabsCo’s proposed token sales, separating research access and advisory input from any later, independently offered equity.

item.title: How to Simulate a Transaction Before Signing It for a Bridge Transfer
item.description: A transaction simulation runs the proposed call against current chain state and previews its expected effects before you sign. For a bridge transfer, that…

item.title: How to find a token contract address in Phantom for a rugcheck
item.description: To find a Solana token contract address in Phantom, open the token and copy its mint address; verify it in Solscan before using it for a risk check.

item.title: Bitcoin Change Outputs: Where the Leftover BTC Goes
item.description: What is a change output in a Bitcoin transaction? It returns leftover BTC to an address you control after the payment and miner fee are accounted for.

item.title: How to Limit Sandwich Loss on a DEX Swap
item.description: How does a sandwich attack work on a DEX swap? A bot trades before and after your order to profit from a worse fill. Tight slippage and private routing reduce exposure.

item.title: How many slices should a TWAP order use for a large trade?
item.description: How many slices should a TWAP order use for a large crypto trade? Start with a tolerable slice size, then check the interval and execution costs.

item.title: stETH vs rETH vs cbETH: which fits restaking?
item.description: stETH vs rETH vs cbETH for restaking comes down to AVS acceptance, issuer trust and exits: stETH is the default, rETH favors permissionless operators, cbETH suits Coinbase exits.

item.title: BlackRock opens Hong Kong tokenized fund with $100 million
item.description: BlackRock’s HKD fund opened with $100 million, pairing blockchain-recorded units and HKDAP settlement with a conventional money-market portfolio.

item.title: EU proposal widens Russia crypto sanctions to third countries
item.description: The EU's proposed 22nd Russia package widens crypto enforcement to payment networks and third countries, but all 27 members must approve it before it takes effect.
